paragraphs: Liberty Broadband Corporation ("Liberty Broadband," "the Company," "us," "we," or "our") is primarily comprised of an equity method investment in Charter.

During May 2014, the board of directors of Liberty Media Corporation and its subsidiaries ("Liberty") authorized management to pursue a plan to spin-off to its stockholders common stock of a wholly owned subsidiary, Liberty Broadband, and to distribute subscription rights to acquire shares of Liberty Broadband's common stock (the "Broadband Spin-Off"). Liberty Broadband was formed in 2014 as a Delaware corporation.

On December 18, 2020, the original GCI Liberty, Inc. ("prior GCI Liberty"), the previous parent company of GCI, was acquired by Liberty Broadband. Through a number of prior years' transactions, Liberty Broadband has acquired an interest in Charter. Liberty Broadband controls 25.01% of the aggregate voting power of Charter as described below in "Business – Ownership Interests."

In July 2025, Liberty Broadband and its subsidiaries completed an internal reorganization preceding the GCI Divestiture (as defined below) to transfer the GCI Business (as defined below) to GCI Liberty, Inc. ("GCI Liberty"). Following the internal reorganization, GCI Liberty owns, directly or indirectly, GCI, LLC and the operations comprising, and the entities that conduct, the GCI Business (collectively, "GCI"). GCI Liberty was a wholly owned subsidiary of Liberty Broadband until the GCI Divestiture, which was completed on July 14, 2025. GCI Liberty is presented as a discontinued operation in the Company's consolidated financial statements. See note 2 to the accompanying consolidated financial statements for details of the GCI Divestiture.

In connection with the Broadband Spin-Off, Liberty and Liberty Broadband entered into certain agreements in order to govern certain of the ongoing relationships between the two companies after the Broadband Spin-Off and to provide for an orderly transition, including a tax sharing agreement, services agreement and a facilities sharing agreement. Additionally, in

connection with a prior transaction, prior GCI Liberty and QVC Group, Inc., formerly Qurate Retail, Inc. ("QVC Group"), entered into a tax sharing agreement, which was assumed by Liberty Broadband as a result of the combination of prior GCI Liberty and Liberty Broadband. The tax sharing agreement provides for the allocation and indemnification of tax liabilities and benefits between QVC Group and Liberty Broadband and other agreements related to tax matters. Under the facilities sharing agreement, Liberty Broadband shares office space with Liberty and related amenities at Liberty's corporate headquarters.

Pursuant to the services agreement, Liberty provides Liberty Broadband with general and administrative services including legal, tax, accounting, treasury, information technology, cybersecurity and investor relations support. Liberty Broadband reimburses Liberty for direct, out-of-pocket expenses incurred by Liberty in providing these services which are negotiated semi-annually, as necessary.

On November 12, 2024, the Company entered into a definitive agreement (the "Merger Agreement") under which Charter has agreed to acquire Liberty Broadband (the "Combination", together with the other transactions contemplated by the Merger Agreement, the "Transactions"). Under the terms of the Merger Agreement, each holder of Liberty Broadband Series A common stock ("LBRDA"), Series B common stock ("LBRDB"), and Series C common stock ("LBRDK") (collectively, "Liberty Broadband common stock") will receive 0.236 of a share of Charter Class A common stock per share of Liberty Broadband common stock held, with cash to be paid in lieu of fractional shares. Each holder of Liberty Broadband Series A cumulative redeemable preferred stock ("Liberty Broadband preferred stock") will receive one share of newly issued Charter Series A cumulative redeemable preferred stock ("Charter preferred stock") per share of Liberty Broadband preferred stock held. The Charter preferred stock will substantially mirror the current terms of the Liberty Broadband preferred stock, including a mandatory redemption date of March 8, 2039. At the special meeting held on February 26, 2025, the requisite holders of LBRDA, LBRDB and Liberty Broadband preferred stock approved the adoption of the Merger Agreement, pursuant to which, among other things, Liberty Broadband will combine with Charter and divested the business of GCI (the "GCI Business").

As discussed above, as a condition to closing the Combination, Liberty Broadband agreed to divest the GCI Business by way of a distribution to the holders of Liberty Broadband common stock (the "GCI Divestiture"), which was completed on July 14, 2025. The GCI Divestiture was taxable to Liberty Broadband and its stockholders, with Charter bearing the corporate level tax liability upon completion of the Combination. If such corporate level tax liability exceeded $420 million, Liberty Broadband (and Charter upon completion of the Combination) would be entitled under a tax receivables agreement to the portion of the tax benefits realized by GCI Liberty corresponding to such excess; however, the corporate level tax liability from the GCI Divestiture is estimated to be significantly less than $420 million.

In addition, in connection with the entry into the Merger Agreement, Charter, Liberty Broadband and Advance/Newhouse Partnership ("A/N") entered into an amendment (the "Stockholders and Letter Agreement Amendment") to (i) that certain Second Amended and Restated Stockholders Agreement, dated as of May 23, 2015 (as amended, the "Stockholders Agreement"), by and among Charter, Liberty Broadband, and A/N, and (ii) that certain Letter Agreement, dated as of February 23, 2021 (the "Letter Agreement"), by and between Charter and Liberty Broadband. Pursuant to the Stockholders and Letter Agreement Amendment, each month during the pendency of the proposed Transactions under the Merger Agreement, Charter is intended to repurchase shares of Charter Class A common stock from Liberty Broadband in an amount equal to the greater of (i) $100 million and (ii) an amount such that immediately after giving effect thereto, Liberty Broadband would have sufficient cash to satisfy certain obligations as set forth in the Stockholders and Letter Agreement Amendment and Merger Agreement, provided that if any repurchase would reduce Liberty Broadband's equity interest in Charter below 25.25% after giving effect to such repurchase or if all or a portion of such repurchase is not permissible, then Charter shall instead loan to Liberty Broadband an amount equal to the lesser of (x) the repurchase amount that cannot be repurchased and (y) an agreed minimum liquidity threshold as set forth in the Stockholders and Letter Agreement Amendment less the repurchase amount that is repurchased, with such loan to occur on the terms set forth in the Stockholders and Letter Agreement Amendment, in each case, subject to certain conditions. Liberty Broadband will remain subject to the existing voting cap of 25.01% as described below in "Business – Ownership Interests." Proceeds from share repurchases applied to debt service are expected to be tax free.

On May 16, 2025, Charter and Cox announced that they entered into a definitive agreement (the "Cox Transaction Agreement") to combine their businesses (the "Cox Transactions"). In connection with this transaction, Liberty Broadband has agreed to accelerate the closing of the Combination to occur contemporaneously with the Cox Transactions. There are no changes to any other transaction terms of the pending Liberty Broadband and Charter transaction.

In connection with the GCI Divestiture, Martin E. Patterson was appointed to the role of President and Chief Executive Officer of Liberty Broadband, effective July 14, 2025. Upon effectiveness of Mr. Patterson's appointment, John C. Malone resigned as President and Chief Executive Officer but remains Chairman of the Board.

On June 19, 2025, Liberty Broadband entered into a Separation and Distribution Agreement (the "Separation and Distribution Agreement"), whereby, subject to the terms thereof, GCI Liberty, a Nevada corporation and a wholly owned subsidiary of Liberty Broadband, would spin-off from Liberty Broadband.

Pursuant to the Separation and Distribution Agreement, the GCI Divestiture was accomplished by means of a distribution by Liberty Broadband of 0.20 of a share of GCI Liberty's Series A, B and C GCI Group common stock (collectively, the "GCI Group common stock"), for each whole share of the corresponding series of Liberty Broadband common stock held as of June 30, 2025 by the holder thereof. The distribution of the GCI Group common stock was completed on July 14, 2025. As a result of the GCI Divestiture, GCI Liberty is an independent, publicly traded company and its businesses, assets and liabilities initially consisted of 100% of the outstanding equity interests in GCI.

headings: Factors Relating to Our Corporate History and Structure
We are a holding company, and we could be unable to obtain cash in amounts sufficient to service our financial obligations or meet our other commitments.

We rely on Charter to provide us with the financial information that we use in accounting for our ownership interest in Charter as well as information regarding Charter that we include in our public filings.
We may become subject to the Investment Company Act.
Our company has overlapping directors and officers with Liberty, GCI Liberty and Liberty Live, which may lead to conflicting interests.
Certain of our inter-company agreements were negotiated while we were a subsidiary of Liberty.
Cyberattacks or other network disruptions could have an adverse effect on our company.
Factors Related to Our and Our Subsidiaries' Indebtedness
We and our subsidiaries have significant indebtedness, which could adversely affect our business and financial condition.

The agreements that govern our and our subsidiaries' current and future indebtedness may contain various affirmative and restrictive covenants that will limit our discretion in the operation of our business.
Variable rate indebtedness subjects us to interest rate risk, which could cause our debt service obligations to increase significantly.
Charter operates in a very competitive business environment, which affects its ability to attract and retain customers and can adversely affect its business, operations and financial results.
Any failure to respond to technological developments and meet customer demand for new products and services could adversely affect its ability to compete effectively.
Charter's business may be adversely affected if Charter cannot continue to license or enforce the intellectual property rights on which its business depends.
Charter may not have the ability to pass on to its customers all of the increases in programming costs, which could adversely affect its cash flow and operating margins.

paragraphs: The risks described below and elsewhere in this annual report are not the only ones that relate to our business or our capitalization. The risks described below are considered to be the most material. However, there may be other unknown or unpredictable economic, business, competitive, regulatory or other factors that also could have material adverse effects on our business. Past financial performance may not be a reliable indicator of future performance and historical trends should not be used to anticipate results or trends in future periods. If any of the events described below were to occur, our business, prospects, financial condition, results of operations and/or cash flows could be materially adversely affected.
The following is a summary of the material risk factors that could adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations:
Factors Relating to Our Corporate History and Structure
● As a holding company, we could be unable to obtain cash in amounts sufficient to service our financial obligations or meet our other commitments.

● Other than cash generated from our participation in Charter's stock repurchase program or cash loaned to us by Charter pursuant to the Stockholders and Letter Agreement Amendment, we do not have access to the cash that Charter generates from its operating activities, and we are subject to Charter's ability to provide such liquidity under the terms of the Merger Agreement.

● We rely on Charter to provide us with the financial information that we use in accounting for our ownership interest in Charter as well as information regarding Charter that we include in our public filings.

Liberty Broadband Corporation ("Liberty Broadband," "the Company," "us," "we," or "our") 主要為一項權益法投資，投資於 Charter。

2014 年 5 月，Liberty Media Corporation 及其子公司 ("Liberty") 的董事會授權管理階層執行一項計畫，將其全資子公司 Liberty Broadband 的普通股分拆發放給股東，並發放認購權以取得 Liberty Broadband 普通股 ("Broadband Spin-Off")。Liberty Broadband 於 2014 年成立為一間德拉瓦州公司。

2020 年 12 月 18 日，原 GCI Liberty, Inc. ("prior GCI Liberty")，即 GCI 之前的母公司，被 Liberty Broadband 收購。透過數年來的交易，Liberty Broadband 已取得 Charter 的權益。Liberty Broadband 控制 Charter 約 25.01% 的投票權，詳情請參見 "業務 – 所有權權益" 部分。

2025 年 7 月，Liberty Broadband 及其子公司完成一項內部重組，以準備 GCI Divestiture (如下所定義)，將 GCI Business (如下所定義) 轉移至 GCI Liberty, Inc. ("GCI Liberty")。內部重組後，GCI Liberty 直接或間接擁有 GCI, LLC 及組成 GCI Business 的運作與實體 (合稱 "GCI")。GCI Liberty 為 Liberty Broadband 的全資子公司，直至 GCI Divestiture 完成，該交易於 2025 年 7 月 14 日完成。GCI Liberty 在本公司合併財務報表中列為已終止營運。詳情請參見隨附合併財務報表的附註 2 中關於 GCI Divestiture 的說明。
為配合 Broadband Spin-Off，Liberty 及 Liberty Broadband 籤訂若干協議，以規範兩家公司於 Broadband Spin-Off 之後的持續關係，並提供有序過渡，包括稅收分攤協議、服務協議及設施共享協議。此外，在

配合一項先前交易，prior GCI Liberty 與 QVC Group, Inc.，原為 Qurate Retail, Inc. ("QVC Group") 籤訂稅收分攤協議，該協議因 prior GCI Liberty 與 Liberty Broadband 合併而由 Liberty Broadband 承繼。稅收分攤協議規範 QVC Group 與 Liberty Broadband 及其他相關協議中稅務負擔與利益的分配與賠償。根據設施共享協議，Liberty Broadband 與 Liberty 共享辦公室空間及 Liberty 董事會大樓相關設施。
根據服務協議，Liberty 向 Liberty Broadband 提供一般及行政服務，包括法律、稅務、會計、財務、資訊科技、網路安全及投資者關係支援。Liberty Broadband 會償還 Liberty 在提供這些服務時所產生的直接、實支費用，費用為每半年協商一次，如需則進行協商。

2024 年 11 月 12 日，本公司與 Charter 簽訂最終協議 ("Merger Agreement")，Charter 同意收購 Liberty Broadband ("Combination"，與 Merger Agreement 所預期的其他交易合稱 "Transactions")。根據 Merger Agreement 的條款，每持有 Liberty Broadband 系列 A 普通股 ("LBRDA")、系列 B 普通股 ("LBRDB") 及系列 C 普通股 ("LBRDK") (合稱 "Liberty Broadband 普通股") 的持有人，將獲得每持有一股 Liberty Broadband 普通股，換取 0.236 股 Charter 系列 A 普通股，不足一股者以現金補足。每持有 Liberty Broadband 系列 A 累積可贖回優先股 ("Liberty Broadband 優先股") 的持有人，將獲得每持有一股 Liberty Broadband 優先股，換取一張新發行的 Charter 系列 A 累積可贖回優先股 ("Charter 優先股")。Charter 優先股將幾乎與 Liberty Broadband 優先股現行條款相同，包括 2039 年 3 月 8 日為強制贖回日。於 2025 年 2 月 26 日特別股東會上，LBRDA、LBRDB 及 Liberty Broadband 優先股的必要持有人批准採納 Merger Agreement，根據該協議，Liberty Broadband 將與 Charter 合併，並放棄 GCI 事業 ("GCI 事業") 的經營。

如上所述，為完成合併，Liberty Broadband 同意將 GCI 事業透過發行給 Liberty Broadband 普通股持有人的方式進行處分（稱為 "GCI 處分"），此處分於 2025 年 7 月 14 日完成。GCI 處分對 Liberty Broadband 及其股東而言屬課稅交易，於合併完成後，Charter 將承擔公司層級的稅務責任。若此公司層級稅務責任超過 420 百萬美元，Liberty Broadband（及於合併完成後的 Charter）將根據稅收應收帳款協議，取得與 GCI Liberty 實際實現之稅務利益相對應的該過剩部分；然而，預估 GCI 處分所產生的公司層級稅務責任顯著低於 420 百萬美元。

此外，為簽訂合併協議，Charter、Liberty Broadband 及 Advance/Newhouse Partnership（"A/N"）簽訂了一項修正案（稱為 "股東與書面協議修正案"），以（i）修正後的第二修正與重述股東協議，於 2015 年 5 月 23 日簽訂（經修正後稱為 "股東協議"），由 Charter、Liberty Broadband 及 A/N 簽訂，以及（ii）於 2021 年 2 月 23 日簽訂的書面協議（稱為 "書面協議"），由 Charter 與 Liberty Broadband 簽訂。根據股東與書面協議修正案，於合併協議下擬議交易進行期間，Charter 每月意圖從 Liberty Broadband 買回 Charter A 普通股，買回數量為（i）100 百萬美元與（ii）使買回後 Liberty Broadband 仍有足夠現金償付協議中所載之義務的金額中較高者；但若任何買回會使 Liberty Broadband 在買回後於 Charter 的權益低於 25.25%，或若全部或部分買回不可行，則 Charter 將貸與 Liberty Broadband 金額為（x）無法買回之買回金額與（y）協議中所載之最低流動性門檻減去已買回金額中較低者，貸款條件依協議中所載，並受某些條件限制。Liberty Broadband 將繼續受原有投票上限 25.01% 之限制，如後述 "業務 – 所有權權益" 所述。用於償還債務之股票買回所得金額預期為稅務無關。
2025 年 5 月 16 日，Charter 與 Cox 宣佈已簽訂一項最終協議（稱為 "Cox 交易協議"），以結合其業務（稱為 "Cox 交易"）。為配合此交易，Liberty Broadband 同意加速合併之完成，使其與 Cox 交易同時進行。目前待處理之 Liberty Broadband 與 Charter 交易之其他條款無任何變更。
為配合 GCI 處分，Martin E. Patterson 被任命為 Liberty Broadband 之總裁與首席執行官，自 2025 年 7 月 14 日起生效。Mr. Patterson 任命生效後，John C. Malone 辭去總裁與首席執行官職務，但繼續擔任董事會主席。
2025 年 6 月 19 日，Liberty Broadband 簽訂一項分離與發行協議（稱為 "分離與發行協議"），依協議條款，GCI Liberty，為內華達州公司且為 Liberty Broadband 之 wholly owned subsidiary，將自 Liberty Broadband 分離出去。

根據分離與發行協議，GCI 處分透過 Liberty Broadband 發行 0.20 份 GCI Liberty 之 Series A、B 與 C GCI Group 普通股（合稱為 "GCI Group 普通股"），對應於 2025 年 6 月 30 日持有 Liberty Broadband 普通股之持有人每持有 1 份整股。GCI Group 普通股之發行於 2025 年 7 月 14 日完成。因 GCI 處分，GCI Liberty 成為一獨立、上市公司，其業務、資產與負債最初為 GCI 全部已發行之權益利益。

Liberty Broadband Corporation ("Liberty Broadband," "the Company," "us," "we," or "our") 主要為持有 Charter Communications, Inc. ("Charter") 之權益法投資。
2014 年 5 月，Liberty Media Corporation 及其子公司 ("Liberty") 董事會授權管理階層執行計畫，將其全資子公司 Liberty Broadband 之普通股分拆發放給股東，並發放認購權以取得 Liberty Broadband 普通股 (稱為 "Broadband Spin-Off")。
2020 年 12 月 18 日，原 GCI Liberty, Inc. ("prior GCI Liberty")，即 GCI 之前母公司，被 Liberty Broadband 收購。

於 2025 年 7 月，Liberty Broadband 及其子公司完成內部重整，以配合 GCI 資產處分，將 GCI 商業業務（如下所定）轉移至 GCI Liberty, Inc.（"GCI Liberty"）。完成內部重整後，GCI Liberty 直接或間接擁有 GCI, LLC 及組成 GCI 商業業務及其營運之實體（合稱 "GCI"）。GCI Liberty 為 Liberty Broadband 的 wholly owned subsidiary，直至 2025 年 7 月 14 日完成 GCI 資產處分。GCI Liberty 在本公司合併財務報表中列為已終止營運。詳情請參閱隨附合併財務報表之附註 2 所述之 GCI 資產處分。
透過多個前年度交易，Liberty Broadband 已取得 Charter 之權益。Liberty Broadband 控制 Charter 累計投票權之 25.01%。

於 2024 年 11 月 12 日，本公司與 Charter 簽訂最終協議（"合併協議"），根據該協議，Charter 同意收購 Liberty Broadband（"組合"，與合併協議所預期的其他交易合稱 "交易"）。根據合併協議的條款，每持有 Liberty Broadband 系列 A 普通股、系列 B 普通股及系列 C 普通股（合稱 "Liberty Broadband 普通股"）的持有人，將獲得每持有 1 股 Liberty Broadband 普通股，可取得 0.236 股 Charter 系列 A 普通股，對於分數股數，將以現金支付。每持有 Liberty Broadband 系列 A 累積可贖回優先股（"Liberty Broadband 優先股"）的持有人，將獲得每持有 1 股 Liberty Broadband 優先股，可取得 1 股新發行的 Charter 系列 A 累積可贖回優先股（"Charter 優先股"）。Charter 優先股將 substantially mirror 當前 Liberty Broadband 優先股的條款，包括 2039 年 3 月 8 日為強制贖回日。於 2025 年 2 月 26 日舉行的特別會議中，Liberty Broadband 系列 A 普通股、系列 B 普通股及系列 A 累積可贖回優先股的必要持有人批准採納合併協議，根據該協議，除其他事項外，Liberty Broadband 將與 Charter 合併，並出售 GCI 的業務（"GCI 事業"）。

此外，於簽訂合併協議時，Charter、Liberty Broadband 及 Advance/Newhouse Partnership（"A/N"）簽訂修正案（"股東及書面協議修正案"），以修正（i）於 2015 年 5 月 23 日簽訂之第二修正重述股東協議（"股東協議"），由 Charter、Liberty Broadband 及 A/N 簽訂，以及（ii）於 2021 年 2 月 23 日簽訂之書面協議（"書面協議"），由 Charter 與 Liberty Broadband 簽訂。根據股東及書面協議修正案，於合併協議所預期之交易進行期間，每月份 Charter 擬定自 Liberty Broadband 購買 Charter 系列 A 普通股，數量為 $100 百萬或使 Liberty Broadband 在考慮該交易後，擁有足夠現金以履行股東及書面協議修正案及合併協議所規定義務之金額，但若任何購回將使 Liberty Broadband 在考慮該購回後，其在 Charter 之權益低於 25.25%，或若所有或部分購回不允許，則 Charter 應貸款給 Liberty Broadband，貸款金額為（x）無法購回之購回金額與（y）協議中所規定之最低流動性門檻減去已購回之金額中之較低者，貸款條件依股東及書面協議修正案所訂。Liberty Broadband 將繼續受現有投票上限 25.01% 之限制，詳情請參閱本年度報告第一部分，第 1 項 "業務 – 所有權權益"。購回股份所得資金用於償還債務，預期為稅務無負擔。
於 2025 年 5 月 16 日，Charter 與 Cox Enterprises, Inc.（"Cox"）宣佈，他們已簽訂最終協議，合併其業務（"Cox 交易"）。配合此交易，Liberty Broadband 同意加速完成合併，使合併於 Cox 交易同時進行。目前其他交易條款均無變動。

如上所述，為完成合併，Liberty Broadband 同意將 GCI 事業透過發放 Liberty Broadband 普通股持有人的方式進行處分（"GCI 處分"），此處分於 2025 年 7 月 14 日完成。GCI 處分對 Liberty Broadband 及其股東而言屬課稅交易，合併完成後，Charter 將承擔公司層級的稅務負擔。若公司層級稅務負擔超過 420 百萬美元，Liberty Broadband（及合併完成後的 Charter）將根據稅收應收款協議，取得 GCI Liberty 所實現之稅務利益中與該過度部分相應的部分；然而，GCI 處分所產生的公司層級稅務負擔預估顯著低於 420 百萬美元。
於 2025 年 6 月 19 日，Liberty Broadband 與 GCI Liberty 簽訂分離與發放協議（"分離與發放協議"），根據協議條款，GCI Liberty 作為內華達州公司且為 Liberty Broadband 的 wholly owned subsidiary，將從 Liberty Broadband 分離出去。

根據分離與發放協議，GCI 處分透過 Liberty Broadband 發放 0.20 份 GCI Liberty 的 Series A、B 與 C GCI Group 普通股（合稱 "GCI Group 普通股"），對應於 2025 年 6 月 30 日持有 Liberty Broadband 普通股的持有人每整份股份。GCI Group 普通股的發放於 2025 年 7 月 14 日完成。因 GCI 處分，GCI Liberty 成為一間獨立且公開上市的公司，其業務、資產與負債最初包含 GCI 全部現有權益。

配合 GCI 處分，Liberty Broadband 與 GCI Liberty 簽訂若干協議，包括分離與發放協議，根據協議，Liberty Broadband 與 GCI Liberty 將對彼此可能產生的損失進行賠償，稅務分享協議（"GCI 稅務分享協議"）與稅收應收款協議（"GCI 稅收應收款協議"）。GCI 稅務分享協議規範 Liberty Broadband 與 GCI Liberty 之間稅務、稅務利益、稅務項目與稅務相關虧損的分配，GCI 稅收應收款協議則規範 Liberty Broadband 與 GCI Liberty 在特定稅務事項上的權利與義務。
因 GCI 處分代表一項戰略轉變，對 Liberty Broadband 的營運與財務結果產生重大影響，因此 GCI Liberty 自 GCI 處分日起被列為已終止營運的業務。

headings: 與我們公司歷史及結構相關的因素
本公司為控股公司，我們可能無法取得足夠現金以償還財務義務或履行其他承諾。
我們依賴 Charter 提供我們用以會計我們對 Charter 的股權利益之財務資訊，以及我們在公開申報文件中包含的有關 Charter 之資訊。
我們可能受投資公司法規制。
本公司與 Liberty、GCI Liberty 及 Liberty Live 有重疊的董事及高階管理人員，這可能會導致利益衝突。
我們部分內部協議是在我們為 Liberty 子公司時談判的。
網路攻擊或其他網路中斷事件可能對本公司產生不利影響。
與本公司及本公司子公司負債相關之因素
本公司及本公司子公司擁有重大負債，可能會對本公司業務及財務狀況產生不利影響。
規範本公司及本公司子公司現有及未來負債之協議，可能包含多種肯定性及限制性契約條款，將限制本公司在業務運作上之自主權。
浮動利率負債使本公司面臨利率風險，可能導致本公司之債務償還義務顯著增加。
Charter 所處之營運環境極為競爭，此情況影響其吸引及留住客戶之能力，並可能對其業務、營運及財務結果產生不利影響。
若 Charter 未能回應科技發展並滿足客戶對新產品及服務之需求，可能影響其有效競爭之能力。
若 Charter 無法持續取得或執行其業務所依賴之智慧財產權權利，其業務可能受到不利影響。
本公司可能無法將程式製作成本的增加全部轉嫁給客戶，這可能會對本公司現金流及營運毛利產生不利影響。

paragraphs: 下列所描述的風險以及本年度報告其他地方所提及的風險，並非唯一與我們業務或資本結構相關的風險。下列所描述的風險被認為是最為重要的。然而，可能存在其他未預見或不可預測的經濟、業務、競爭、法規或其他因素，也可能對我們的業務產生重大不利影響。過去的財務表現未必是未來表現的可靠指標，歷史趨勢也不應用來預測未來期間的結果或趨勢。若下列所描述的任何事件發生，將可能對我們的業務、前景、財務狀況、營運結果及/或現金流產生重大不利影響。
下列為可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果產生不利影響的重要風險因素摘要：
與我們公司歷史及結構相關的因素
● 作為一家控股公司，我們可能無法取得足夠的現金以償還財務義務或履行其他承諾。
● 除了我們參與 Charter 股票回購計劃所產生的現金，或 Charter 根據股東及書面協議修正案貸款給我們的現金外，我們無法取得 Charter 從其營運活動所產生的現金，且我們受 Charter 根據合併協議條款提供流動性的能力所限制。
● 我們依賴 Charter 提供我們用以會計我們在 Charter 中的股權權益的財務資訊，以及我們在公開檔中包含的有關 Charter 的資訊。
